blind.description: A stylized fantasy crest monument composed of a stepped rectangular stone/metal plinth supporting an upright blue shield with silver trim and wing motifs, fronted by an upright broadsword pointing downward. The pommel has a diamond-shaped blue gem, the grip is wrapped in blue, and the crossguard is silver. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a stylized hand-painted fantasy art style.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an angled silver crest rim with the sword pommel and upper crossguard at the center, resting on the flared rectangular base below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the base and shield.
